title: Local Services campaigns  |  Google Ads API  |  Google for Developers

facts.fact: Starting in API version v24, existing Local Services Performance Max campaigns created in the UI by allowlisted accounts can be retrieved and updated through the Google Ads API.
facts.quote: Starting in **`v24`**, you can retrieve and update existing Local Services Performance Max campaigns

facts.fact: Starting in API version v26, new Local Services Performance Max campaigns can be created through the Google Ads API.
facts.quote: Starting in **`v26`**, you can also [create new Local Services Performance Max campaigns]

facts.fact: The Google Ads API does not support creating or removing Local Services campaigns, or operations on their ad groups, ads, or criteria.
facts.quote: Creating and removing Local Services campaigns, as well as operations on sub-entities like ad groups, ads, or criteria within these campaigns, are not supported by the Google Ads API.

facts.fact: For Local Services campaigns, the API allows updating the campaign's status and the associated campaign budget's amount_micros field.
ManualCpa and MaximizeConversions are the bidding strategies the API lets you set as the standard bidding strategy of Local Services campaigns.
facts.quote: You can set the following bidding strategies as the standard bidding strategy of Local Services campaigns:

facts.fact: Local Services campaigns are retrieved by querying Campaign resources where advertising_channel_type is 'LOCAL_SERVICES'.
Lead feedback and ratings for Local Services leads can be submitted using the ProvideLeadFeedback() method.
facts.quote: You can submit feedback and rating for leads using the `ProvideLeadFeedback()` method
